method: Source: /home/lawrence/Physics/Ga2O3-Net/results/phase65/transport_llm_extracted_v2.csv (549 rows). Eligibility: non-empty 'quote' AND at least one non-null numeric field among carrier_cm3/mu_cm2Vs/rho_ohmcm/concentration_value (all 549 rows eligible). Sample: pandas DataFrame.sample(n=100, random_state=42), deterministic. Each sampled row was read and judged manually by the auditing LLM (Claude, Fable 5): the stored verbatim quote was compared against every non-null numeric field in the row. Rules: numeric equivalence across notations (2.5e18 == 2.5x10^18 cm-3, OCR/glyph artifacts like '9'=x and (cid:N), float round-trip artifacts e.g. 9.5499e16==9.55e16) counts as SUPPORTED; a quote stating a range containing the value, a bound (>/<) recorded as a point value, a unit-less table fragment whose numbers match, a unit mismatch (sheet cm^-2 vs volume cm^-3), or only a subset of the row's fields present in the quote = PARTIAL; quote lacking / contradicting the value(s) (e.g. instrument-methods sentences with no numbers) = UNSUPPORTED; placeholder tag 'phase77_ingest' instead of a quote, or a quote truncated before the value = UNJUDGEABLE. Verdict per row is the weakest applicable grade across its checked fields, except UNJUDGEABLE which reflects missing/truncated quote text.
